project_title: GRC Dashboard - Vulnerability Risk Level & Affected Applications Blueprint

layout_architecture.mobile_behavior: At 390px, stack vertically in 1 column (`grid-cols-1`), add horizontal overflow scrolling for tables, reduce padding to `p-4`, ensure touch targets are minimum 44px height.

risk_level_panel.description: Interactive horizontal bar chart / distribution list placed alongside Severity Panel.
interactive_features: Clickable risk bars (Crítico, Alto, Medio-Alto, Medio, Bajo) with multi-select state
Visual active indicator (glow/border highlight when selected)
Counter badge for total vulnerabilities per risk level
Clear multi-select filter button inside card header

multi_select_filtering_logic.operator_within_group: OR (Selecting 'Alto' and 'Medio-Alto' returns vulnerabilities matching either risk level)
multi_select_filtering_logic.operator_between_groups: AND (Combining Risk Level filters with Severity filters requires vulnerabilities to satisfy both condition sets)

filter_bar_toggle.description: Unified interactive filter pill bar above or within chart headers displaying active selections

affected_applications_panel.description: Grid / Table view located below distribution charts showcasing affected software applications.
features: Real-time updated vulnerability counts respecting active severity & risk filters
Instant text search input for application names
Pagination controls (rows per page & page switcher)
Vulnerability severity breakdown chips per application card/row
Clicking an application opens the detailed vulnerability drill-down modal

vulnerability_detail_modal.description: Full detail paginated dialog displaying vulnerabilities for the selected application under active global filters.
components: Header showing App Name, Total Count, Active Filters Summary
Paginated table with columns: Code, Name, Severity, Risk Level, Status, Remediation Date, Actions

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Preserve dark GRC aesthetic consistent with DashboardGRC.jsx using slate color palette.
Ensure contrast ratio exceeds WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text).
Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-5 or p-6) to prevent text collision.
NO complete transparent background in headers, dropdowns, or overlays.
All interactive elements MUST include explicit hover, focus, and active states with text color specified.
Include data-testid on all buttons, filters, search inputs, modal containers, and pagination controls for automated testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: Integrate 'Panel Nivel de Riesgo' next to 'Panel de Severidad' in DashboardGRC.jsx.
Place 'Panel de Aplicaciones Afectadas' directly below both panels spanning full width.
Implement multi-selection toggle state for Risk Levels and Severities with OR within group and AND between groups logic.
Ensure global dashboard filters (period, domain, institution) are preserved and passed down to vulnerability detail queries.
Provide responsive design for 390px mobile view and desktop 1920px view.
